post.originalText:
Opus 5.5 solves animation. Watch this. Sound on. 🤯

The prompt was essentially: 

"Use Dynamic Workflows and create an animation depicting a movie shoot about Opus 5.5's efficiency in Claude Code"

Full prompt is below. Borrow it.

How Claude worked:

1. Ultracode turned Claude into an orchestrator

2. First workflow was a "pre-production" writer's room

3. Parallel agents built the character, sets and render pipeline

4. The soundtrack is entirely Python (!)

5. Seven scenes built with an adversarial reviewer

6. A "polish" workflow ran to do quality control

7. I had to get on a flight in the middle of the workflow running. Claude gracefully picked it back up once I got to my destination

https://t.co/iFqC0kBLkK
